chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: Alphonso Trent's band in Tulsa and its young players
summary: Seeing Trent's band in Tulsa inspired him to form a big band; Trent had Lee Hilliard and Leslie Sheffield, whom Love later worked with.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Again, right at that time, T. Holder began to come to. He came on back, but of course, before then, what encouraged me to go for the band, Al Trent, Alphonso Trent would come to Tulsa and I would just stand in front of his band and he had a youngster in there, Lee Hilliard; he played trumpet and alto.
Trumpet and alto. He was younger than me, I think he was even in his teens then, and they had another youngster, Leslie Sheffield--
I worked with him. We went to Canada together in 1943. Leslie died recently in Oklahoma City.
